description: Analyze a package's registry publish history for the staged worm pattern (a 0.0.0-stage stub, a decoy release, then a rapid regressed patch holding dist-tags.latest), plus publisher and maintainer changes, repository slug changes, and provenance drops between consecutive versions. The registry defaults to npm; with registry pypi it reads PyPI history instead (the same timeline checks, plus yanked-version findings, since PyPI publishes no per-version publisher data). Registry metadata only; no tarballs are downloaded.

name.description: Package name, for example lodash or @scope/name

registry.description: Registry to read history from (default npm)

name: check_history
